scope: Tests only; no application, model, protocol or UI changes.

checks.decodedEquality: Every RGBA byte, including zero-alpha RGB, equals input.
checks.pngOracle: Independent bitwise CRC, Node zlib/Adler decoding and exact filter/scanline validation.
checks.metricOracle: Hand-derived geometry, checker parity, encoded RGB RMSE and linear luminance denominators.

limits: The additional tests have not yet passed the full project static/native CI gate.
Uploaded-art perception and protection are not measured; no experiment fit was performed.
Nested root-array refusal is not an isolated measurement of parser depth enforcement.

corrections: Required title accessor is rejected without invocation.
Same-project different-image commit is rejected atomically.
Each RGB luminance coefficient and the low-sRGB branch have isolated expectations.
review.guardMutations: Removing each accessor/image guard or changing the red luminance coefficient fails its actual fixture.
